new_findings.text: Correction to the lane_impact of the surviving BattleUI finding, which says the HUD needs 'a Change Stance button NEXT TO the portrait'. It is not next to the portrait — it IS the portrait. Android names the clickable §1t5158s0§ 'battlemodebust' (BattleUI.as:26), the same object that receives the player bust at :148 ('battlemodebust.bustcanvas.addChild(this.playerBust)') and carries the stance ring at :374 ('battlemodebust.stancecolor1.gotoAndStop(num)'). The 'Change Stance' label is a HOVER TOOLTIP, not a persistent button caption: android :192-193 adds MOUSE_OVER/MOUSE_OUT -> showChangeStanceLabel/hideChangeStanceLabel, and the web twin does the identical thing at §1t113s0§.as:241-242 (MOUSE_OVER/MOUSE_OUT -> §1t5215s0§/§1t5216s0§) with :542 '§1t5161s0§.visible = true;' / :548 '... = false;' and :200 hiding it at init. A porter following the lane_impact literally would ship a spurious second HUD widget.
new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud: the stance control is the portrait bust itself (buttonMode, highlight child, stancecolor1 ring); the getString(208) label renders only on hover. Do not author a standalone Change Stance button.

new_findings.text: The stance-mastery finding disclosed its own parity hole in its build field ('android v0.682 data XML + web v0.717 formula') because the floor=1 evidence was StatsManager.as, an android file. That hole is now closed from the web side: §1t1523s0§.as:2583-2593 is the web v0.717 new-character seed and it pushes the identical seven skill stats at value 1 — '§1t9367s0§.push(new §1t100s0§(1000,1));' / (1001,1) / (1002,1) / (1003,1) / (1042,1) / (1049,1) / (1050,1) — a line-for-line twin of StatsManager.as:740-746. So mastery floor 1 (Light x0.54, Balanced x1.02) is attested in v0.717 itself and does not depend on the android build.
new_findings.lane_impact: L2 skills-meters: the [1,10] mastery domain no longer carries an S0-3/C2 build-parity caveat.

new_findings.text: String 960 and its grey label are not merely missing from the android string table — the android build has no code path that would use them. Android BattleUI.as:259-263 updateReload is two lines: 'this.reloadbar.bar.scaleX = percentage;' and 'this.crittext.visible = percentage >= 1 && this.reloadbar.visible;'. There is no ratio==0 branch and no second htmlText. The web v0.717 twin §1t113s0§.as:326-359 adds all three states (grey getString(960) at ratio 0, hidden at 0<r<1, black getString(175) + Snd_criticalDamage at r>=1) and rescales the input to '(param1 - 48) / (param2 - 48)' where android passes a pre-computed percentage. This explains why strings.json has no key '960' without needing a table-coverage argument, and it is a real, dated v0.682 -> v0.717 HUD change.
new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud: ship the three-state meter label from the WEB contract; do not port android's two-line updateReload. Also: the 48 offset lives in the UI rescale, mirroring §1t99s0§.as:3050's gate.

new_findings.text: The replacement for the ledger's dead 'HARD-LOCKED' line, stated positively so it can be ported. In-combat stance change in v0.717 requires BOTH conditions of §1t99s0§.as:3048-3051: '§1t4470s0§() { return this.§1t4469s0§() && this.§1t4414s0§ >= 48; }', where §1t4469s0§ (:3043-3046) is an actionState whitelist (§1t11141s0§, §1t11150s0§, §1t11142s0§, §1t11143s0§, §1t11198s0§, or §1t11169s0§ with a matching previous state §1t3251s0§). On success §1t4472s0§ (:3058-3080) cycles -1 -> §1t12220s0§ -> §1t12221s0§ -> §1t12222s0§ -> §1t12220s0§ and re-guards with its own 'if(this.§1t4414s0§ < 48) return;'; on failure BattleUI plays Snd_error (§1t113s0§.as:478). Note the cycle is THREE stances wide even though §1t99s0§.as:3266-3268 gives §1t12222s0§/§1t12223s0§/§1t12224s0§ the same fixed x1.4 damage.
new_findings.ledger_text: **In-combat stance is HARD-LOCKED in v0.717** ("CANNOT CHANGE STANCE"). The recreation's Focus-gated in-combat switch models **removed 2014 behavior**.
new_findings.lane_impact: L5 combat-core: replace the hard-lock with gate = (actionState in whitelist) && reloadMeter >= 48, cycling Light->Balanced->Heavy->Light, Snd_smallClick on success / Snd_error on refusal.

new_findings.text: Nobody has established, from an artifact that ties COLOUR to STAT, that the green bar is HP and the blue bar is Chi. The code proves only that there are exactly two numeric updaters and one numeral-free one: android BattleUI.as:245-249 updateHp (hptext/hptextshadow/hpbar) and :252-256 updateChi (chitext/chitextshadow/chibar), whose web twins are §1t113s0§.as:312-317 (§1t5171s0§/§1t5172s0§/§1t5170s0§ = hptext/hptextshadow/hpbar) and :319-324 (§1t5165s0§/§1t5166s0§/§1t5164s0§ = chitext/chitextshadow/chibar), matched by call-order against the empty setReloadMax (:241-243) / §1t5200s0§ and updateReload/§1t5205s0§ that bracket them. Nothing in AS3 names a colour — the fills live in SWF art. The surviving 'video-study notes misread' finding asserts green=HP / blue=Chi, and B-11:7 asserts the exact opposite ('a thin green bar ... reads as a resource/stamina-type meter, NOT the blue HP bar ... a thick blue bar ... (this is HP)'). Circumstantial support for green=HP: REBUILD_READINESS.md:178 is Kheshav's own-eyes verdict on Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0 and reads 'player HP 20/20', and in that frame green is 20/20 while blue is 26/26; and across my three frames the green denominator is pinned at 20 (20/20, 14/20, 11/20) with its numerator falling during combat, while the blue denominator varies 26/31/47. That is inference plus one A5 line, not a colour-to-stat artifact. Flagging it because it would silently corrupt palette.ts and the config bar names, and because two committed docs currently disagree.
new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud: before writing bar colours to config, find an artifact that binds colour to stat (a low-HP/death frame, or the SWF shape for hpbar). Do not inherit green=HP from prose on either side.

new_findings.text: Byproduct of judging this packet: the web-to-android field map for §1t113s0§ (BattleUI) now covers eight more members beyond the three the packet claimed, all fixed by matching call order and body shape against the android twin. §1t5158s0§ = battlemodebust (:148-149 highlight/buttonMode == android :112-113); §1t5170s0§/§1t5171s0§/§1t5172s0§ = hpbar/hptext/hptextshadow (:312-317 == android :244-249); §1t5164s0§/§1t5165s0§/§1t5166s0§ = chibar/chitext/chitextshadow (:319-324 == android :251-256); §1t5200s0§ = setReloadMax (both empty bodies, :308-310 == android :241-243); §1t5205s0§ = updateReload (:326 == android :259); §1t5215s0§/§1t5216s0§ = showChangeStanceLabel/hideChangeStanceLabel (:241-242,:542,:548 == android :192-193,:433,:439). Together with the packet's §1t5169s0§=crittext, §1t5161s0§=changestancelabel, §1t5182s0§=reloadbar, that is the whole player-status cluster of the combat HUD decoded.
new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud: unblocks the rest of the BattleUI port without further guessing at obfuscated field names.
